_note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file containing only dictionary and variable assignments. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines hyperparameters, model architecture, training pipelines, and dataset settings for the PartA2 3D object detection model on KITTI.
summarize_config: summarize the PartA2 MMDetection3D config for KITTI 3D object detection with 3 classes
review_model_architecture: review the PartA2 model architecture config including voxel encoder, SparseUNet, SECOND backbone, and SECONDFPN neck
review_train_pipeline: review the training data augmentation pipeline including ObjectSample, ObjectNoise, RandomFlip3D, and GlobalRotScaleTrans
review_rpn_head: review the PartA2RPNHead config with FocalLoss classification and SmoothL1Loss bounding box regression
review_roi_head: review the PartAggregationROIHead config with PointwiseSemanticHead and PartA2BboxHead for 3D detection
